selection: Ten analytic head edits; four whole-group folds inside existing fitting groups. Maximize minimum supported-class recall, then macro-F1, then accuracy, then name. Refit selected head on all fitting queries; publish selection before evaluation. Backbone was previously fitted on these groups, so folds validate head calibration only.
objective: Class-balanced squared error to one-hot labels; hidden normalization per training fold; positive ridge; unpenalized intercept; fixed logit scale4. Fold normalization into code.weight/bias. No gradient descent or optimizer. Only code head and optionally23GRU history columns change.
requirements: All fitting-supported evaluation codes: recall>=.25 and precision>=.10. Overall code accuracy loss<=.05, movement accuracy loss<=.01, movementNLL increase<=.01, goalwithin2 loss<=.02 and mean goalerror increase<=.25 vs original S01. No claim of zero misses; any unseen evaluation code prevents complete coverage.
scope: Previously exposed research data; inferred hindsight labels. No subagents, playing-bot edits, new replay payloads, or automatic promotion. Original and V44 checkpoints preserved.
